$comment: Every direct dependency needs an entry here: what it is used for. The build and a unit test fail otherwise.

vite.purpose: Dev server and production build. Adds a few lines of module-loading code to the page.

typescript.purpose: Type checking of the strict TypeScript sources.

vitest.purpose: Runs the unit, fuzz and soak tests.

fast-check.purpose: Generates random levels and move sequences for the fuzz tests.

@playwright/test.purpose: Browser tests, the browser benchmark and the showcase screenshots.

globals.purpose: Lists of browser and Node globals for ESLint.

@types/node.purpose: Type definitions for the Node build, benchmark and test scripts.
